description: Table I pipeline with the authors' notebook settings (commit 0411494): code data settings (lengthscale 0.3, nonstat c = 2.0, sigmoid(+cx)), M = 500, R = 128 Sobol draws (seed 12345), n = L = 4, the code's Gaussian noise model with N = 10000 and 16 MoM groups (seed 123), approximate gradient (rank 32, 16 Hutchinson probes, seed 1028), 400 iterations x 3 rounds.
